summary: Pre-Congestion Notification (PCN) protects quality of service for inelastic flows in a Diffserv domain by marking packets when traffic rates pass configured levels. This informational RFC gives an overview of the ways PCN information was considered for encoding in the IP header.

eli5.summary: Traffic lights mark when a road is getting busy before a jam. This memo looks at the different ways to write that sign inside a packet.

questions: how is pcn information encoded in ip headers
